rationale: Edge LE079, inherited from adoc-literature-v0.2.0 as an 'ADOC continuity readout gate' on the reported stromal phenotype. U5b (docs/v05_mechanistic_integration_plan.md section 17) removes it in adoc-literature-superset-v0.5.1 because S_PRL is a calibration readout (OM-002 / SOFIA-STR-001) and a reported phenotype must not use an observation marker as a causal gate. The conjunct is absorbed in all 524288 free-variable assignments, so the composed function of every node is unchanged; the effect is transient only and is measured in docs/u5b_readout_repair/. The row and its evidence are retained as history, as PAR-005 retains LE081. The category name is the repository's only retirement category and describes PAR-005's origin; this retirement is documented and deliberate, not an undocumented migration. Version-local: v0.4.0 and v0.5.0 still execute this edge and pin the shared adjudication file's hash, so the row cannot live there.
